items.question: Trong câu "A Project Manager is accountable for getting a project to its destination within committed constraints — not for building the product.", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Project Manager is accountable for getting a project to its destination within committed constraints — not for building the product.", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm giải trình. "Be accountable for X" = chịu trách nhiệm cuối cùng về X và phải giải trình khi có vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊn.tə.bəl/ (adjective): answerable for the result. "Be accountable for X" means you answer for X if it goes wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "A Project Manager is accountable for getting a project to its destination within committed constraints — not for building the product.", từ "destination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Project Manager is accountable for getting a project to its destination within committed constraints — not for building the product.", what does "destination" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the place you are going to
items.explanation: destination /ˌdes.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đích đến. Dễ nhầm với destiny (số phận). "Reach the destination" = tới đích.
items.explanationEn: destination /ˌdes.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the place you are going to. Not to be confused with destiny. "Reach the destination" means arrive.

items.question: Trong câu "A Project Manager is accountable for getting a project to its destination within committed constraints — not for building the product.", từ "constraint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A Project Manager is accountable for getting a project to its destination within committed constraints — not for building the product.", what does "constraint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (danh từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. Tam giác ràng buộc: scope, time, cost. "Within constraints" = trong giới hạn cho phép.
items.explanationEn: constraint /kənˈstreɪnt/ (noun): a limit or restriction. The constraint triangle is scope, time, cost. "Within constraints" means inside the limits.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM does not write code, design screens, or write detailed requirements.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM does not write code, design screens, or write detailed requirements.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪə.mənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu. Động từ: require. "Functional requirements" = yêu cầu chức năng.
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪə.mənt/ (noun): something needed or demanded. Verb: require. "Functional requirements" describe what a system must do.

items.question: Trong câu "The PM's job is creating the conditions in which the people doing those things can do them well, and keeping the whole project visible to decision-makers.", từ "visible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM's job is creating the conditions in which the people doing those things can do them well, and keeping the whole project visible to decision-makers.", what does "visible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: visible /ˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (tính từ): minh bạch, dễ nhìn thấy. Danh từ: visibility. "Keep X visible to Y" = giúp Y luôn nắm được X.
items.explanationEn: visible /ˈvɪz.ə.bəl/ (adjective): clearly seen and known. Noun: visibility. "Keep X visible to Y" means make sure Y can see it.

items.question: Trong câu "The PM's job is creating the conditions in which the people doing those things can do them well, and keeping the whole project visible to decision-makers.", từ "decision-maker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The PM's job is creating the conditions in which the people doing those things can do them well, and keeping the whole project visible to decision-makers.", what does "decision-maker" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decision-maker /dɪˈsɪʒ.ən ˌmeɪ.kər/ (danh từ): người ra quyết định. Thường là lãnh đạo hoặc sponsor có quyền duyệt ngân sách, phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: decision-maker /dɪˈsɪʒ.ən ˌmeɪ.kər/ (noun): a person who decides. Usually leaders or sponsors who approve budget and scope.

items.question: Trong câu "If you must define the PM job in one sentence: a PM turns uncertainty into decisions that can be acted on.", từ "uncertainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you must define the PM job in one sentence: a PM turns uncertainty into decisions that can be acted on.", what does "uncertainty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (danh từ): sự không chắc chắn. Trái nghĩa: certainty. "Deal with uncertainty" = xử lý tình huống chưa rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (noun): a state of not knowing. Opposite: certainty. "Deal with uncertainty" means work when things are unclear.

items.question: Trong câu "If you must define the PM job in one sentence: a PM turns uncertainty into decisions that can be acted on.", từ "act on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you must define the PM job in one sentence: a PM turns uncertainty into decisions that can be acted on.", what does "act on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: act on /ˈækt ɒn/ (cụm từ): hành động dựa trên. "Act on advice / information" = làm theo lời khuyên / thông tin.
items.explanationEn: act on /ˈækt ɒn/ (phrase): to take action based on. "Act on advice or information" means do something because of it.

items.question: Trong câu "A very common misreading: that a PM tracks progress and updates spreadsheets.", từ "misreading" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A very common misreading: that a PM tracks progress and updates spreadsheets.", what does "misreading" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriː.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu sai. Tiền tố mis- = sai: misunderstand, misjudge, misreading.
items.explanationEn: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriː.dɪŋ/ (noun): a wrong interpretation. The prefix mis- means wrongly: misunderstand, misjudge, misreading.

items.question: Trong câu "A very common misreading: that a PM tracks progress and updates spreadsheets.", từ "track" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A very common misreading: that a PM tracks progress and updates spreadsheets.", what does "track" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: track /træk/ (động từ): theo dõi. "Keep track of" = theo dõi, nắm được. Danh từ track = đường ray, bài hát.
items.explanationEn: track /træk/ (verb): to follow and monitor. "Keep track of" means stay informed about. As a noun, a track is a rail line or song.

items.question: Trong câu "A real PM makes trade-off decisions, and every one of them displeases somebody.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real PM makes trade-off decisions, and every one of them displeases somebody.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: giving up one thing to gain another
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Make a trade-off between speed and quality" = đánh đổi giữa tốc độ và chất lượng.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): giving up one thing to gain another. "Make a trade-off between speed and quality" means sacrifice one for the other.

items.question: Trong câu "A real PM makes trade-off decisions, and every one of them displeases somebody.", từ "displease" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A real PM makes trade-off decisions, and every one of them displeases somebody.", what does "displease" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: displease /dɪsˈpliːz/ (động từ): làm phật lòng. Tiền tố dis- phủ định please. Mỗi quyết định đánh đổi đều làm ai đó không vui.
items.explanationEn: displease /dɪsˈpliːz/ (verb): to make unhappy. dis- negates please; every trade-off leaves someone unhappy.

items.question: Trong câu "The rule: you cannot fix all three.", từ "fix" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The rule: you cannot fix all three.", what does "fix" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set so it cannot change
items.explanation: fix /fɪks/ (động từ): cố định, chốt. Nghĩa quen thuộc là sửa lỗi; ở đây là chốt cứng phạm vi, thời gian, chi phí.
items.explanationEn: fix /fɪks/ (verb): to set so it cannot change. Usually means repair; here it means lock scope, time and cost in place.

items.question: Trong câu "Fix all three and quality becomes the only remaining variable, and it will drop without anyone deciding to let it.", từ "remaining" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fix all three and quality becomes the only remaining variable, and it will drop without anyone deciding to let it.", what does "remaining" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remaining /rɪˈmeɪ.nɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn lại. Động từ remain = vẫn còn. "The remaining tasks" = các việc còn lại.
items.explanationEn: remaining /rɪˈmeɪ.nɪŋ/ (adjective): still left. Verb remain = stay. "The remaining tasks" are the ones left.

items.question: Trong câu "Three ways to respond under pressure:", từ "under pressure" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three ways to respond under pressure:", what does "under pressure" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: under pressure /ˈʌn.dər ˈpreʃ.ər/ (cụm từ): khi bị áp lực. "Work well under pressure" = làm tốt khi bị áp lực — cụm hay gặp trong phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: under pressure /ˈʌn.dər ˈpreʃ.ər/ (phrase): while being pushed hard. "Work well under pressure" is a common interview phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "What PMs commonly get wrong: accepting the commitment and hoping the team will work overtime to cover it.", từ "commitment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What PMs commonly get wrong: accepting the commitment and hoping the team will work overtime to cover it.", what does "commitment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): cam kết. "Make a commitment" = đưa ra cam kết; dễ nhầm với commission, committee.
items.explanationEn: commitment /kəˈmɪt.mənt/ (noun): a promise to deliver. "Make a commitment" means promise; do not confuse with commission or committee.

items.question: Trong câu "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", từ "borrow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", what does "borrow" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take for a time and give back
items.explanation: borrow /ˈbɒr.əʊ/ (động từ): vay, mượn. Borrow (mượn vào) khác lend (cho mượn). Ở đây làm thêm giờ là "vay" thời gian.
items.explanationEn: borrow /ˈbɒr.əʊ/ (verb): to take for a time and give back. Borrow is to take; lend is to give. Overtime "borrows" time from the future.

items.question: Trong câu "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", từ "repay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", what does "repay" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (động từ): trả lại, đền bù. Danh từ: repayment. "Repay a loan" = trả nợ.
items.explanationEn: repay /rɪˈpeɪ/ (verb): to pay back. Noun: repayment. "Repay a loan" means pay it back.

items.question: Trong câu "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. Trong kiểm thử, defect ≈ bug. Động từ defect /dɪˈfekt/ = đào tẩu.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. In testing a defect is roughly a bug. The verb defect means switch sides.

items.question: Trong câu "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", từ "sustained" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", what does "sustained" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sustained /səˈsteɪnd/ (tính từ): kéo dài liên tục. Động từ sustain = duy trì. "Sustainable pace" = nhịp làm việc bền vững.
items.explanationEn: sustained /səˈsteɪnd/ (adjective): continuing for a long time. Verb sustain = keep going. "Sustainable pace" is a key agile idea.

items.question: Trong câu "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", từ "productivity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays them with months: more defects, good people leaving, and a sustained drop in productivity.", what does "productivity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: productivity /ˌprɒd.ʌkˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng suất. Tính từ: productive. "A drop in productivity" = năng suất giảm.
items.explanationEn: productivity /ˌprɒd.ʌkˈtɪv.ə.ti/ (noun): output per effort. Adjective: productive. "A drop in productivity" means less gets done.

items.question: Trong câu "In Agile the triangle is usually inverted: time and cost are fixed (one sprint, one team) while scope is the variable.", từ "invert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Agile the triangle is usually inverted: time and cost are fixed (one sprint, one team) while scope is the variable.", what does "invert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invert /ɪnˈvɜːt/ (động từ): đảo ngược. Danh từ: inversion. Agile đảo ngược tam giác: cố định thời gian và chi phí.
items.explanationEn: invert /ɪnˈvɜːt/ (verb): to turn upside down. Noun: inversion. Agile flips the triangle by fixing time and cost.

items.question: Trong câu "These are three different roles, and the most commonly confused ones in the industry.", từ "confuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These are three different roles, and the most commonly confused ones in the industry.", what does "confuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (động từ): nhầm lẫn. "Confuse A with B" = nhầm A với B; tính từ confusing = gây rối.
items.explanationEn: confuse /kənˈfjuːz/ (verb): to mix up. "Confuse A with B" means mix them up; confusing means hard to understand.

items.question: Trong câu "The core difference: a PROJECT has an end date, a PRODUCT does not.", từ "core" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The core difference: a PROJECT has an end date, a PRODUCT does not.", what does "core" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (tính từ): cốt lõi. Danh từ core = lõi (nhân CPU). "Core values" = giá trị cốt lõi.
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (adjective): central, most basic. As a noun, a core is the centre (e.g. CPU core). "Core values" are the basic ones.

items.question: Trong câu "In Vietnamese practice: in an outsourcing company the PM is the central role because every contract is a project with an end date.", từ "outsourcing" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Vietnamese practice: in an outsourcing company the PM is the central role because every contract is a project with an end date.", what does "outsourcing" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: contracting work to an outside firm
items.explanation: outsourcing /ˈaʊt.sɔː.sɪŋ/ (danh từ): gia công, thuê ngoài. Động từ: outsource. Công ty outsourcing làm dự án theo hợp đồng cho khách.
items.explanationEn: outsourcing /ˈaʊt.sɔː.sɪŋ/ (noun): contracting work to an outside firm. Verb: outsource. An outsourcing firm delivers contracted projects for clients.

items.question: Trong câu "In a product company the PM role is usually thinner and most of the responsibility is split between the Product Owner and the Engineering Manager.", từ "thin" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a product company the PM role is usually thinner and most of the responsibility is split between the Product Owner and the Engineering Manager.", what does "thin" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: thin /θɪn/ (tính từ): mỏng, ít vai trò. "A thin role" = vai trò có ít trách nhiệm; nghĩa gốc là mỏng, gầy.
items.explanationEn: thin /θɪn/ (adjective): having a small scope. "A thin role" carries few responsibilities; literally thin means not thick.

items.question: Trong câu "In a product company the PM role is usually thinner and most of the responsibility is split between the Product Owner and the Engineering Manager.", từ "responsibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In a product company the PM role is usually thinner and most of the responsibility is split between the Product Owner and the Engineering Manager.", what does "responsibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: responsibility /rɪˌspɒn.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm. "Take responsibility for" = nhận trách nhiệm về.
items.explanationEn: responsibility /rɪˌspɒn.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): a duty you must handle. "Take responsibility for" means accept the duty for something.

items.question: Trong câu "The same PM title at these two kinds of company can be two completely different jobs — ask explicitly in interviews.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same PM title at these two kinds of company can be two completely different jobs — ask explicitly in interviews.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, trực tiếp
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, trực tiếp. Trái nghĩa: implicitly. "State explicitly" = nói rõ ràng.
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly. Opposite: implicitly. "State explicitly" means say it plainly.

items.question: Trong câu "Deciding with incomplete information.", từ "incomplete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deciding with incomplete information.", what does "incomplete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: incomplete /ˌɪn.kəmˈpliːt/ (tính từ): không đầy đủ. Tiền tố in- phủ định. "Incomplete data" = dữ liệu thiếu.
items.explanationEn: incomplete /ˌɪn.kəmˈpliːt/ (adjective): not complete. The prefix in- negates. "Incomplete data" is missing parts.

items.question: Trong câu "Your job is deciding with what you have, recording the assumption, and adjusting as you learn — rather than waiting for certainty that never arrives.", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your job is deciding with what you have, recording the assumption, and adjusting as you learn — rather than waiting for certainty that never arrives.", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: something taken as true without proof
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. Động từ: assume. "Record the assumption" = ghi lại giả định để kiểm tra sau.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something taken as true without proof. Verb: assume. "Record the assumption" so you can check it later.

items.question: Trong câu "Your job is deciding with what you have, recording the assumption, and adjusting as you learn — rather than waiting for certainty that never arrives.", từ "adjust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your job is deciding with what you have, recording the assumption, and adjusting as you learn — rather than waiting for certainty that never arrives.", what does "adjust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (động từ): điều chỉnh. Danh từ: adjustment. "Adjust the plan" = điều chỉnh kế hoạch.
items.explanationEn: adjust /əˈdʒʌst/ (verb): to change slightly. Noun: adjustment. "Adjust the plan" means modify it.

items.question: Trong câu "Your job is deciding with what you have, recording the assumption, and adjusting as you learn — rather than waiting for certainty that never arrives.", từ "certainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your job is deciding with what you have, recording the assumption, and adjusting as you learn — rather than waiting for certainty that never arrives.", what does "certainty" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: certainty /ˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (danh từ): sự chắc chắn. "With certainty" = một cách chắc chắn; trái nghĩa uncertainty.
items.explanationEn: certainty /ˈsɜː.tən.ti/ (noun): the state of being sure. "With certainty" means surely; opposite uncertainty.

items.question: Trong câu "A late decision is usually worse than an imperfect one made early and corrected in time.", từ "imperfect" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A late decision is usually worse than an imperfect one made early and corrected in time.", what does "imperfect" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: imperfect /ɪmˈpɜː.fɪkt/ (tính từ): chưa hoàn hảo. Tiền tố im- trước p: imperfect, impossible, impatient.
items.explanationEn: imperfect /ɪmˈpɜː.fɪkt/ (adjective): not perfect. The prefix im- comes before p: imperfect, impossible, impatient.

items.question: Trong câu "A late decision is usually worse than an imperfect one made early and corrected in time.", từ "in time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A late decision is usually worse than an imperfect one made early and corrected in time.", what does "in time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in time /ɪn ˈtaɪm/ (cụm từ): kịp lúc. "In time" = kịp (trước khi quá muộn); "on time" = đúng giờ đã định.
items.explanationEn: in time /ɪn ˈtaɪm/ (phrase): early enough. "In time" means early enough; "on time" means at the scheduled time.

items.question: Trong câu "Layered communication.", từ "layered" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Layered communication.", what does "layered" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: layered /ˈleɪ.əd/ (tính từ): phân tầng, nhiều lớp. Danh từ layer = lớp, tầng. Giao tiếp phân tầng: mỗi đối tượng một mức chi tiết.
items.explanationEn: layered /ˈleɪ.əd/ (adjective): arranged in levels. Noun layer = level. Layered communication gives each audience its own detail.

items.question: Trong câu "To management: impact on schedule, cost, risk — and what you recommend.", từ "recommend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To management: impact on schedule, cost, risk — and what you recommend.", what does "recommend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recommend /ˌrek.əˈmend/ (động từ): đề xuất, khuyến nghị. Danh từ: recommendation. Báo cáo lên trên nên kèm đề xuất cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: recommend /ˌrek.əˈmend/ (verb): to suggest as best. Noun: recommendation. Reports to management should include one.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who reads a full technical report to the board has not done their job.", từ "board" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who reads a full technical report to the board has not done their job.", what does "board" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: board /bɔːd/ (danh từ): hội đồng quản trị. "Board of directors" = hội đồng quản trị; "on board" = đồng thuận, tham gia.
items.explanationEn: board /bɔːd/ (noun): a company's directors. "Board of directors" runs a company; "on board" means in agreement.

items.question: Trong câu "Influence without authority.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Influence without authority.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "The authorities" = nhà chức trách; "an authority on X" = chuyên gia về X.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the power to give orders. "The authorities" are officials; "an authority on X" is an expert.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM is usually nobody's line manager.", từ "line manager" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM is usually nobody's line manager.", what does "line manager" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: line manager /ˈlaɪn ˌmæn.ɪ.dʒər/ (danh từ): quản lý trực tiếp. Line manager duyệt lương, đánh giá hiệu suất; PM thường không có quyền này.
items.explanationEn: line manager /ˈlaɪn ˌmæn.ɪ.dʒər/ (noun): your direct boss. A line manager handles pay and reviews; a PM usually does not.

items.question: Trong câu "You do not set salaries or promotions.", từ "promotion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You do not set salaries or promotions.", what does "promotion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a move to a higher job
items.explanation: promotion /prəˈməʊ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thăng chức. "Get a promotion" = được thăng chức; trong marketing là khuyến mãi.
items.explanationEn: promotion /prəˈməʊ.ʃən/ (noun): a move to a higher job. "Get a promotion" means move up; in marketing it means a sales offer.

items.question: Trong câu "Your tools are credibility, clarity, and whether you actually shield the team.", từ "credibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your tools are credibility, clarity, and whether you actually shield the team.", what does "credibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): uy tín, sự đáng tin. Tính từ: credible. "Lose credibility" = mất uy tín.
items.explanationEn: credibility /ˌkred.əˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): being trusted and believed. Adjective: credible. "Lose credibility" means stop being trusted.

items.question: Trong câu "Your tools are credibility, clarity, and whether you actually shield the team.", từ "shield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your tools are credibility, clarity, and whether you actually shield the team.", what does "shield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shield /ʃiːld/ (động từ): che chắn, bảo vệ. Danh từ shield = cái khiên. "Shield the team from pressure" = che chắn đội khỏi áp lực.
items.explanationEn: shield /ʃiːld/ (verb): to protect. Noun shield = a protective plate. "Shield the team from pressure" means protect it.

items.question: Trong câu "Refusing without data is obstruction; refusing with an impact analysis is protecting the project.", từ "obstruction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refusing without data is obstruction; refusing with an impact analysis is protecting the project.", what does "obstruction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: obstruction /əbˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cản trở. Động từ: obstruct. Từ chối không có dữ liệu là cản trở.
items.explanationEn: obstruction /əbˈstrʌk.ʃən/ (noun): blocking progress. Verb: obstruct. Refusing without data just blocks progress.

items.question: Trong câu "Refusing without data is obstruction; refusing with an impact analysis is protecting the project.", từ "refuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Refusing without data is obstruction; refusing with an impact analysis is protecting the project.", what does "refuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (động từ): từ chối. Danh từ: refusal. Danh từ refuse /ˈref.juːs/ lại là rác thải.
items.explanationEn: refuse /rɪˈfjuːz/ (verb): to say no to. Noun: refusal. The noun refuse, stressed on the first syllable, means rubbish.

items.question: Trong câu "Look at the real state of work in flight, rather than waiting for Friday.", từ "in flight" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look at the real state of work in flight, rather than waiting for Friday.", what does "in flight" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in flight /ɪn ˈflaɪt/ (cụm từ): đang được thực hiện. "Work in flight" = công việc đang làm dở; nghĩa đen là đang bay.
items.explanationEn: in flight /ɪn ˈflaɪt/ (phrase): currently in progress. "Work in flight" is work under way; literally it means flying.

items.question: Trong câu "Clear impediments the team raises — the highest-value work of the day.", từ "impediment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clear impediments the team raises — the highest-value work of the day.", what does "impediment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impediment /ɪmˈped.ɪ.mənt/ (danh từ): trở ngại. Trong Scrum, impediment = vật cản khiến đội không làm tiếp được.
items.explanationEn: impediment /ɪmˈped.ɪ.mənt/ (noun): an obstacle. In Scrum an impediment is anything stopping the team from progressing.

items.question: Trong câu "Compare actual against plan and update the forecast, not just the record of the past.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compare actual against plan and update the forecast, not just the record of the past.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (danh từ): dự báo. "Weather forecast" = dự báo thời tiết; "forecast delivery" = dự báo ngày giao.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (noun): a prediction of the future. "Weather forecast" is the everyday use; PMs forecast delivery dates.

items.question: Trong câu "Review the risk register — add new ones, close spent ones, update changed ones.", từ "register" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review the risk register — add new ones, close spent ones, update changed ones.", what does "register" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (danh từ): sổ theo dõi, danh mục. "Risk register" = sổ đăng ký rủi ro; động từ register = đăng ký.
items.explanationEn: register /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stər/ (noun): an official list or log. A "risk register" logs risks; the verb register means sign up.

items.question: Trong câu "Review the risk register — add new ones, close spent ones, update changed ones.", từ "spent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review the risk register — add new ones, close spent ones, update changed ones.", what does "spent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: spent /spent/ (tính từ): đã hết tác dụng. "A spent risk" = rủi ro đã qua; "a spent force" = thế lực đã hết thời.
items.explanationEn: spent /spent/ (adjective): used up, no longer active. "A spent risk" has passed; "a spent force" has lost its power.

items.question: Trong câu "Report status to stakeholders, including what you need from them.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Report status to stakeholders, including what you need from them.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪk.həʊl.dər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. Stakeholder rộng hơn shareholder (cổ đông): gồm khách, sếp, đội, người dùng.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪk.həʊl.dər/ (noun): anyone affected by the project. Broader than shareholder: clients, managers, team and users.

items.question: Trong câu "Talk privately with a few team members to hear what never surfaces in meetings.", từ "privately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Talk privately with a few team members to hear what never surfaces in meetings.", what does "privately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: privately /ˈpraɪ.vət.li/ (trạng từ): riêng tư. Nói chuyện riêng giúp nghe được điều người ta ngại nói trong họp.
items.explanationEn: privately /ˈpraɪ.vət.li/ (adverb): in private. Private talks reveal what people will not say in meetings.

items.question: Trong câu "Talk privately with a few team members to hear what never surfaces in meetings.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Talk privately with a few team members to hear what never surfaces in meetings.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, nổi lên. Danh từ surface = bề mặt. "Issues surface" = vấn đề lộ ra.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to come to light. Noun surface = top layer. "Issues surface" means they become known.

items.question: Trong câu "Common routes into the role:", từ "route" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Common routes into the role:", what does "route" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: route /ruːt/ (danh từ): con đường, lộ trình. "Route into" = con đường dẫn tới (nghề); đồng âm gần root (gốc).
items.explanationEn: route /ruːt/ (noun): a path to a goal. "Route into" a career is the path there; do not confuse with root.

items.question: Trong câu "Advantage: understands the real work and estimates credibly.", từ "estimate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Advantage: understands the real work and estimates credibly.", what does "estimate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (động từ): ước lượng. Danh từ estimate /ˈes.tɪ.mət/. "Estimate effort" = ước lượng công sức.
items.explanationEn: estimate /ˈes.tɪ.meɪt/ (verb): to judge roughly. The noun is pronounced differently. "Estimate effort" means gauge the work.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: tends to jump in and do it rather than letting the team.", từ "tend to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: tends to jump in and do it rather than letting the team.", what does "tend to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tend to /ˈtend tuː/ (cụm từ): có xu hướng. "Tend to + V" = hay làm gì; "tend (to) a garden" = chăm vườn.
items.explanationEn: tend to /ˈtend tuː/ (phrase): to usually do. "Tend to + verb" means usually; "tend a garden" means care for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: tends to jump in and do it rather than letting the team.", từ "jump in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: tends to jump in and do it rather than letting the team.", what does "jump in" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to step in and take over
items.explanation: jump in /ˈdʒʌmp ɪn/ (cụm từ): nhảy vào làm thay. "Jump in" = can thiệp làm luôn; PM xuất thân kỹ thuật dễ mắc lỗi này.
items.explanationEn: jump in /ˈdʒʌmp ɪn/ (phrase): to step in and take over. "Jump in" means take over the work; ex-engineers often do this.

items.question: Trong câu "Advantage: strong grasp of the business and stakeholders.", từ "grasp" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Advantage: strong grasp of the business and stakeholders.", what does "grasp" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: grasp /ɡrɑːsp/ (danh từ): sự nắm vững, hiểu biết. "Have a good grasp of" = hiểu rõ; động từ grasp = nắm lấy.
items.explanationEn: grasp /ɡrɑːsp/ (noun): a firm understanding. "Have a good grasp of" means understand well; the verb grasp means grip.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: leaning toward form over substance.", từ "substance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: leaning toward form over substance.", what does "substance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: substance /ˈsʌb.stəns/ (danh từ): thực chất, nội dung. "Form over substance" = trọng hình thức hơn thực chất.
items.explanationEn: substance /ˈsʌb.stəns/ (noun): real content. "Form over substance" means valuing appearance over real content.

items.question: Trong câu "Risk: leaning toward form over substance.", từ "lean toward" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Risk: leaning toward form over substance.", what does "lean toward" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lean toward /ˈliːn təˈwɔːd/ (cụm từ): nghiêng về. "Lean toward(s) an option" = thiên về một lựa chọn.
items.explanationEn: lean toward /ˈliːn təˈwɔːd/ (phrase): to tend to prefer. "Lean toward(s) an option" means favour it.

items.question: Trong câu "The team raises problems instead of hiding them until they cannot be hidden.", từ "raise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team raises problems instead of hiding them until they cannot be hidden.", what does "raise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: raise /reɪz/ (động từ): nêu ra. "Raise an issue / a concern" = nêu vấn đề / mối lo ngại.
items.explanationEn: raise /reɪz/ (verb): to bring up for discussion. "Raise an issue or concern" means bring it up.

items.question: Trong câu "This only happens when the PM does not punish the messenger.", từ "punish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This only happens when the PM does not punish the messenger.", what does "punish" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make suffer for a fault
items.explanation: punish /ˈpʌn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): trừng phạt. "Don't shoot the messenger" là thành ngữ cùng ý: đừng trách người báo tin xấu.
items.explanationEn: punish /ˈpʌn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to make suffer for a fault. The idiom "don't shoot the messenger" means the same: do not blame the bearer.

items.question: Trong câu "This only happens when the PM does not punish the messenger.", từ "messenger" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This only happens when the PM does not punish the messenger.", what does "messenger" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: messenger /ˈmes.ɪn.dʒər/ (danh từ): người đưa tin. Ở đây là người báo tin xấu; "messenger app" mới là ứng dụng nhắn tin.
items.explanationEn: messenger /ˈmes.ɪn.dʒər/ (noun): a person carrying news. Here the one bringing bad news; a "messenger app" is for chatting.

items.question: Trong câu "Forecasts get steadily more accurate.", từ "accurate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Forecasts get steadily more accurate.", what does "accurate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accurate /ˈæk.jə.rət/ (tính từ): chính xác. Danh từ: accuracy. "Accurate estimate" = ước lượng sát thực tế.
items.explanationEn: accurate /ˈæk.jə.rət/ (adjective): correct and exact. Noun: accuracy. An "accurate estimate" is close to reality.

items.question: Trong câu "If everything stops, the PM is a bottleneck rather than an enabler.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If everything stops, the PM is a bottleneck rather than an enabler.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. "Performance bottleneck" = điểm nghẽn hiệu năng.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒt.əl.nek/ (noun): a point that slows everything. "Performance bottleneck" is the slowest part of a system.

items.question: Trong câu "If everything stops, the PM is a bottleneck rather than an enabler.", từ "enabler" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If everything stops, the PM is a bottleneck rather than an enabler.", what does "enabler" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: enabler /ɪˈneɪ.blər/ (danh từ): người tạo điều kiện. Động từ enable = cho phép, tạo điều kiện.
items.explanationEn: enabler /ɪˈneɪ.blər/ (noun): someone who makes things possible. Verb enable = make possible.

items.question: Trong câu "On certifications: PMP and PRINCE2 help in traditional environments and for passing CV screens; PMI-ACP and Scrum certifications suit agile ones.", từ "screen" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On certifications: PMP and PRINCE2 help in traditional environments and for passing CV screens; PMI-ACP and Scrum certifications suit agile ones.", what does "screen" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: screen /skriːn/ (danh từ): vòng sàng lọc. "CV screen" = vòng lọc hồ sơ; động từ screen = sàng lọc.
items.explanationEn: screen /skriːn/ (noun): a filtering check. A "CV screen" filters applicants; the verb screen means filter.

items.question: Trong câu "On certifications: PMP and PRINCE2 help in traditional environments and for passing CV screens; PMI-ACP and Scrum certifications suit agile ones.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On certifications: PMP and PRINCE2 help in traditional environments and for passing CV screens; PMI-ACP and Scrum certifications suit agile ones.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. Danh từ suit = bộ vest, vụ kiện (lawsuit). Tính từ: suitable.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. Noun suit = a set of clothes or a lawsuit. Adjective: suitable.

items.question: Trong câu "But no certification substitutes for one project you took to the finish and can narrate in detail.", từ "substitute for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But no certification substitutes for one project you took to the finish and can narrate in detail.", what does "substitute for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: substitute for /ˈsʌb.stɪ.tjuːt fɔːr/ (cụm từ): thay thế cho. "Nothing substitutes for experience" = không gì thay được kinh nghiệm.
items.explanationEn: substitute for /ˈsʌb.stɪ.tjuːt fɔːr/ (phrase): to take the place of. "Nothing substitutes for experience" means experience is irreplaceable.

items.question: Trong câu "But no certification substitutes for one project you took to the finish and can narrate in detail.", từ "narrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But no certification substitutes for one project you took to the finish and can narrate in detail.", what does "narrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: narrate /nəˈreɪt/ (động từ): kể lại, thuật lại. Danh từ: narrative, narrator. Phỏng vấn PM thường yêu cầu kể một dự án cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: narrate /nəˈreɪt/ (verb): to tell as a story. Nouns: narrative, narrator. PM interviews often ask you to walk through a project.

items.question: Trong câu "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays with months of defects, attrition and lost productivity.", từ "attrition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Overtime borrows a few weeks and repays with months of defects, attrition and lost productivity.", what does "attrition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attrition /əˈtrɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): tỉ lệ nghỉ việc. "Staff attrition rate" = tỉ lệ nhân viên nghỉ việc.
items.explanationEn: attrition /əˈtrɪʃ.ən/ (noun): staff leaving over time. "Staff attrition rate" is how fast employees leave.

items.question: Trong câu "In Agile time and cost are fixed and scope is the variable — hence the ordered backlog.", từ "hence" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Agile time and cost are fixed and scope is the variable — hence the ordered backlog.", what does "hence" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: hence /hens/ (trạng từ): vì thế, do đó. Hence thường đứng trước cụm danh từ: "hence the delay" = do đó mới trễ.
items.explanationEn: hence /hens/ (adverb): for this reason. Hence often precedes a noun phrase: "hence the delay".

items.question: Trong câu "A PM usually has no formal authority — the tools are credibility, clarity, and shielding the team.", từ "formal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM usually has no formal authority — the tools are credibility, clarity, and shielding the team.", what does "formal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: formal /ˈfɔː.məl/ (tính từ): chính thức. "Formal authority" = quyền hạn chính thức theo chức vụ.
items.explanationEn: formal /ˈfɔː.məl/ (adjective): officially granted. "Formal authority" comes with a job title.

items.question: Trong câu "The constraint triangle is a daily negotiation tool, and Agile inverts it by fixing time and cost.", từ "negotiation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The constraint triangle is a daily negotiation tool, and Agile inverts it by fixing time and cost.", what does "negotiation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: negotiation /nɪˌɡəʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự đàm phán. Động từ: negotiate. "Negotiate scope" = thương lượng phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: negotiation /nɪˌɡəʊ.ʃiˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): discussion to reach agreement. Verb: negotiate. "Negotiate scope" means agree on what is included.

items.question: Trong câu "The four decisive skills are deciding under uncertainty, layered communication, influence without authority, and saying no with evidence.", từ "decisive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The four decisive skills are deciding under uncertainty, layered communication, influence without authority, and saying no with evidence.", what does "decisive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: decisive /dɪˈsaɪ.sɪv/ (tính từ): mang tính quyết định. "Decisive" còn nghĩa là quả quyết (người); dễ nhầm với divisive (gây chia rẽ).
items.explanationEn: decisive /dɪˈsaɪ.sɪv/ (adjective): determining the result. Decisive also means firm (of a person); do not confuse with divisive.
